novelty_search.nearest_results: The generic will/had screen found full attention 9 recovery 0.3575 but skipped head follow-up because no module reached its generic 0.50 bar. The prospective MLP4-local-V9 edge was a valid magnitude null at 0.04992 while preserving 99% local-value dominance. H1/H4 are established readers for has/had and is/was, but have not been tested against their seven-head complement on will/had.
novelty_search.new_question: Do the already chosen L9H1/H4 heads capture the broader will/had attention-9 effect through inputs beyond MLP4, or is the new construction routed through the seven-head complement?

population: All 128 sealed will/had A1/A2/P/C rows. Native and full-attention-9 logits are frozen from the parent screen; only donor capture plus H1/H4-only and seven-head-complement patches are new.

factorial.no_rescue: No layer, head, row, family, threshold, sign, or aggregation changes after execution.

opposing_predictions.shared_reader_group: H1/H4 recover at least half of full attention 9 in every A1/A2 direction cell, with donorward fraction at least 0.75 and no larger normalized P/C movement than the full module.
opposing_predictions.different_reader_group: H1/H4 fail the registered target fraction or selectivity bar; the complement and interaction report where the remaining effect resides.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_pa: All hashes, native capability cells, cached head coverage, finite logits, frozen full-attention coverage, and exact 128-row evidence coverage pass.
predictions.pred_b_shared_h1h4_reader_group: H1/H4 mean recovery is at least 0.50 of the frozen full-attention-9 recovery in every A1/A2 direction cell and donorward fraction is at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_controls_selective: H1/H4 mean absolute normalized movement is no greater than the frozen full-attention-9 movement in P and C.
predictions.pred_d_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 12 model forwards and 384 example evaluations, with zero fits/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-D pass: the established H1/H4 reader group generalizes to the new will/had construction despite the bounded MLP4 edge.
terminal.null: The instrument passes but H1/H4 target fraction or control selectivity fails; retain the exact complement and interaction as a bounded grouping null.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, cache, coverage, finiteness, frozen-corner, or price checks fail.

scope: A screen groups the attention-9 reader heads only; it does not identify their new upstream sources or the full will/had circuit.
